entities.name: Abbasid Caliphate
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The third Islamic caliphate (750–1258), centered in Baghdad. Under the Abbasids, the Islamic Golden Age flourished with the House of Wisdom translating Greek, Persian, and Indian texts, advancing science, philosophy, and medicine.
